# Wedding Website Build Prompt

Copy everything below into your AI coding tool (Claude Code, Cowork, etc.), then fill in the bracketed fields before sending.

---

## Prompt

Build me a wedding website. It should be elegant, chic, and simple — clean typography, generous white space, a restrained color palette, and effortless navigation on both desktop and mobile. Password-protect the whole site behind a single shared passcode gate before any content loads.

### 1. Couple & Story
- Names: Tatianna Zoe Bollwerk & David Dean
- How we met / our story (2–4 short paragraphs): [text]
- Proposal story (optional): [text]
- Photos to feature (I will provide files): [engagement photo, couple photo, etc.]

### 2. Wedding Details
- Wedding date: July 17, 2027
- Ceremony time & location (venue name, full address): Xylokastro, Greece
- Reception time & location (if different): Xylokastro, Greece
- Dress code / attire: [e.g., black tie, cocktail, garden formal]
- Weather / season notes (optional): [text]

### 3. Schedule / Itinerary
List each event (welcome drinks, rehearsal dinner, ceremony, reception, farewell brunch, etc.) with time, location, and whether it's open to all guests or invite-only:
- [Event]: [time] — [location] — [guest list note]

### 4. Travel & Accommodations
- Recommended hotels (name, address, group rate/code, booking link): [list]
- Airport(s) and general transit guidance: [text]
- Shuttle or parking info: [text]
- Local recommendations (restaurants, things to do) — optional: [list]

### 5. RSVP
- RSVP deadline: [date]
- Do you need a form that captures: attending yes/no, number of guests, meal choice, dietary restrictions, song requests, notes? [list which fields you want]
- Where should responses go? (e.g., email notification, spreadsheet export, or just store in-app) [preference]

### 6. Registry
- Registry links (Amazon, Zola, Crate & Barrel, etc.): [links]
- Honeymoon fund / cash gift note (optional): [text]

### 7. Wedding Party
- Names, roles (maid of honor, best man, bridesmaid, groomsman, etc.), and a short fun fact or one-line bio for each — optional: [list]

### 8. Photo Gallery
- Do you want an engagement/couple photo gallery? [yes/no]
- Will guests be able to upload their own photos during/after the wedding? [yes/no]

### 9. FAQ
Common questions to answer (edit/add as needed):
- Can I bring a plus-one / are kids welcome?
- What's the weather usually like?
- Is there parking or a shuttle?
- What should I wear?
- [Add any of your own]

### 10. Design Preferences
- Color palette: [e.g., sage green & ivory, terracotta & cream, navy & gold]
- Style mood: [e.g., minimalist, romantic garden, modern black-tie, coastal]
- Fonts: [serif headings / sans-serif body, or "surprise me elegantly"]
- Any reference websites or Pinterest boards you like: [links]

### 11. Site Structure
Build these pages/sections, in this order, accessible via a simple sticky nav:
1. Landing/Home — names, date, a short welcome line, elegant hero image or monogram
2. Our Story
3. Event Details / Schedule
4. Travel & Accommodations
5. RSVP
6. Registry
7. Wedding Party
8. Gallery
9. FAQ

### 12. Technical Requirements
- Password protection: single shared password gate before the site is viewable (no per-guest accounts needed)
- Fully responsive (mobile-first, since most guests will view on phones)
- Fast-loading, minimal animation — subtle fade-ins only, nothing distracting
- Easy for me to update text/dates/photos later
- [Add hosting preference if you have one, e.g., "deployable as a static site"]

---

## How to fill this out
Replace every bracketed placeholder with your real information, delete any sections you don't need (e.g., Wedding Party if you're not featuring one), and paste photos/files in when you send the prompt. The more specific you are about colors, tone, and must-have content, the closer the first draft will land to what you want.
